text:
Clare H: Heads-up — planning to run the infra apply during Friday's release window (20:00 UTC). Change touches TGW routing + a tiny IAM binding. Proposal: commit .terraform.lock.hcl, pin provider in versions.tf, and run a throttled canary (10% traffic) for 30m before full rollout. Also want an automatic pause if error rate > 5%.

Jonathan M: +1 for lockfile and pin. Without .terraform.lock.hcl we risk different provider plugins during canaries. Suggest provider pin like:

```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 4.60.0"
    }
  }
}
```

Also set backend state lock TTL to 60m for the window.

Samir K: Will run plan in infra-canary workspace first. Plan command I ran locally looked fine: no destructive changes aside from route table replacement (we expect one replace). Plan snippet:

```bash
terraform workspace select infra-canary || terraform workspace new infra-canary
terraform plan -out=canary.plan
terraform show -json canary.plan | jq '.resource_changes[] | {address: .address, change: .change.actions}'
```

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed. terraform fmt, validate OK. Remote state lock available. Plan uploaded: canary.plan. Note: detected provider diff vs lockfile: 1 -> please ensure .terraform.lock.hcl is up to date before apply.

Clare H: Good — I'll push .terraform.lock.hcl and the versions.tf pin now. @Samir K can you run canary apply once CI green? Will tag infra-oncall for monitoring.

Samir K: On it. Quick checklist for canary apply:
- workspace: infra-canary
- canary traffic: 10% (route table priority + sticky session tests)
- smoke tests: api-ping, e2e-login, background-jobs status
- metrics to watch: 5xx rate, connect latency, route propagation errors

infra-oncall: I'll be oncall during window. What's the escape hatch?

Jonathan M: Escape hatch plan (short):
1) Pause rollout: deploybot can run
   `deploybot rollout pause --release infra/2278`
2) Rollback to previous infra version (state snapshot) if canary >=5% errors:
   `deploybot apply --workspace=infra-canary --rollback-to=state@prev`
3) If route-table replacement caused packet loss: reattach old route table via console script (handbook link) and open immediate incident channel.

Clare H: Adding a deploybot flag to enforce canary throttle and auto-pause: `--canary=10% --canary-duration=30m --auto-pause-threshold=5%`. Can we get a dry-run of those flags?

deploy-bot: Dry-run: `deploybot apply --workspace=infra-canary --canary=10% --canary-duration=30m --auto-pause-threshold=5% --dry-run` -> Succeeds. Will not mutate state.

Samir K: Running canary apply in ~15m after CI finishes. Will run smoke tests and paste results. If green, escalate to 50% for 20m, then full. If any infra-oncall flags, I'll hold.

infra-oncall: Two operational notes:
- IAM binding change requires KMS key access check. If KMS denies, we should rollback IAM only (quick revert) and re-run after key fix.
- Add a release-note snippet under release/infra -> describe the route-table swap and the small IAM tweak, mention mitigation steps.

Clare H: Added release note draft: "Routing change to consolidate TGW route priorities; small IAM binding to allow monitoring role read-only access to encr keys. Canary 10% for 30m; rollback criteria: >5% errors or any KMS denies." Please edit.

Samir K: Canary apply started. Pastes:
```
Appying canary (10%)...
terraform apply -auto-approve canary.plan
-- replacing aws_route_table.rtbl_app (create before destroy)
Smoke: api-ping OK
e2e-login OK
background-jobs OK
Metrics: 0.3% 5xx, latency unchanged
```

deploy-bot: Canary reached 10%. No errors detected. Proceeding to 50% step in 30m unless infra-oncall requests hold.

infra-oncall: Holding watch. If 5xx > 5% in next 30m I will request pause. Also verify route propagation metrics in cloud-metrics dashboard.

Clare H: Thanks everyone. Post-canary we will do provider plugin audit and a follow-up to commit any lockfile changes to main. If rollback needed, follow Jonathan's escape hatch steps and ping #incidents.

Samir K: Canary completed successfully. Moving to 50% now. Will post final status before full rollout. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary -> 50% completed. No automated pauses. Final apply scheduled in 40m to finish the window.

Clare H: Final check: anyone object to full apply? Otherwise we'll go full at 21:30 UTC.

Jonathan M: No objections from infra. Approved.

infra-oncall: Approved. I'll stay oncall until 22:30 UTC.
